title: Pruning Autonomous Driving VLAs: What to Preserve for Reasoning and Action
abstract: arXiv:2611.31240v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reasoning vision-language-action (VLA) models for autonomous driving use chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning to guide action generation, but incur substantial memory and computational costs. We study structured pruning for these models, focusing on preserving both scene understanding and trajectory prediction. Our analysis of Taylor importance in Alpamayo-1.5-10B shows that reasoning and trajectory objectives assign different importance to the same vision-language model (VLM) structures. In the action expert, MLP channels exhibit more stable importance rankings across denoising steps than query heads, and a small fraction of channels accounts for most of the measured importance. Based on these findings, we propose MoOP, which combines importance ranks from both objectives for VLM pruning and aggregates stepwise importance to select a fixed subset of expert MLP channels. translated_title: 自动驾驶视觉-语言-动作模型的剪枝：为推理与动作应保留什么
translated_abstract: 面向自动驾驶的推理型视觉-语言-动作模型使用思维链推理来引导动作生成，但会带来大量的内存与计算开销。我们研究针对这类模型的结构化剪枝，重点关注同时保留场景理解与轨迹预测能力。我们对 Alpamayo-1.5-10B 中 Taylor 重要性的分析表明，推理目标与轨迹目标会对相同的视觉-语言模型（VLM）结构赋予不同的重要性。在动作专家模块中，MLP 通道在不同去噪步骤间的重要性排序比查询头更加稳定，且一小部分通道占据了所测重要性的大部分。基于这些发现，我们提出了 MoOP，该方法结合来自两个目标的重要性排序对 VLM 进行剪枝，并聚合逐步重要性以选取固定的专家 MLP 通道子集。在总参数量减少 24.0% 的情况下，仅对 VLM 使用 MoOP 剪枝的性能表现……
tldr: 提出MoOP剪枝方法，融合推理与轨迹两个目标的重要性排序来剪枝VLM并聚合去噪步骤间的重要性以选取专家MLP通道，在约24%参数削减下同时保留场景理解与轨迹预测能力。
en_tdlr: MoOP is proposed, a structured pruning method that combines importance rankings from both reasoning and trajectory objectives for VLM pruning and aggregates stepwise importance to select expert MLP channels, preserving scene understanding and trajectory prediction at a 24.0% total parameter reduction.
